question: Which of the drugs reviewed could produce esophagitis if not administered properly ?:

analysis: Alendronate is a bisphosphonate that can cause esophagitis if not taken properly. It is important for patients to take it with a full glass of water and remain upright for at least 30 minutes to prevent esophageal irritation. The other drugs listed do not have this specific risk associated with their administration.
